work.name: Docplanner
work.summary:
Payments team (full remote): led infrastructure work with .NET, AWS and Kubernetes. Built PHP features with DDD, CQRS and AI-assisted development.
  • Led a new payment feature for two markets with a new payment provider, from design to production.
  • AI-assisted engineering with Claude Code and Cursor: built 8 skills and tools used by the whole team (payment-provider sandbox, read-only production database access, message-template checkers) and improved 27 shared skills. Learned .NET with AI support.
  • Built an AI skill to manage test environments and adapted it to a new testing platform. Ran AI training sessions and a cross-team demo.
  • Built payment alerting as code with Datadog, OpenTelemetry and runbooks that caught a silent onboarding outage. Led an incident recovery that got back 82% of the affected value.
  • Delivered key parts of Spain's e-invoicing compliance (VeriFactu) under a legal deadline, and closed authorization gaps in fiscal invoicing.
  • Stabilized the invoicing service and cut its cost on my own initiative: Redis to DragonflyDB, horizontal scaling, unused databases removed.
  • Team multiplier: set up cloud dev environments for several backend and frontend apps, adopted company-wide. Mentored four engineers.
